## Research at a glance

<div class="grid-cards"><div><h3>Plant molecular biology</h3><p>Plant pathways, regeneration, transformation, and molecular improvement.</p></div><div><h3>Lipid metabolism</h3><p>TAG biosynthesis, fatty-acid profiles, and metabolic pathway redesign.</p></div><div><h3>Analytical biochemistry</h3><p>LC-MS/MS, GC-MS/MS, chromatography, and computational interpretation.</p></div></div>

## Current direction

My current research focuses on engineering sunflower plants for altered lipid composition and increased triacylglycerol content, integrating plant tissue culture, molecular biology, CRISPR-based approaches, and lipid analysis.

> My long-term goal is to become an independent researcher and Principal Scientist working at the interface of experimental biology, analytical instrumentation, and computational research.
